intended_application: A read-only assistant drafts evidence-linked comparison briefs for packaging-supplier RFQs from the same sanitized historical bid packets and approved supplier records. Buyers verify every material claim against the source. Existing sourcing approval stays manual. The assistant cannot send messages, score or select suppliers, or write to procurement systems.
business_need: Reduce buyer time spent assembling comparable packaging bids while preserving accuracy and an auditable approval trail.
users_stakeholders: Category buyers, category managers, procurement operations, IT/security, and sourcing approvers.
adoption_posture: Moderate fast-follower with a preference for reversible trials.
risk_consequence_context: Wrong prices, terms, or omissions can distort a sourcing decision. Bid confidentiality and traceability matter. The existing manual comparison and approval process remains available.
management_question: Can the organization run a bounded pilot now and what must it demonstrate before operational rollout?
time_horizon: Decide this week, assess a four-week pilot if eligible, and make a rollout decision within 90 days.
additional_context: Fictional matched test scenarios dated 2026-11-09. Treat supplied organizational details as scenario facts, not independently verified observations. The model, data scope, workflow boundary, strategic premise, and risk are held constant. No model performance or ROI data are supplied. NIST AI 600-1 (2024-07-26), section 2.2 and GOVERN 3.2 (https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1), describes confabulation and offers voluntary guidance for oversight and feedback. This does not establish any legal obligation, case facts, or performance result.
capabilities_constraints: The procurement director signed a pilot charter and named the procurement operations manager as coordinator. Two buyers completed a source-check and escalation rehearsal, and a category manager signs a manual comparison before any sourcing approval. IT/security approved the read-only sandbox and sanitized data boundary. A procurement analyst checked supplier IDs and revision labels for all 20 historical packets against the approved source. The charter funds sandbox usage and protects four reviewer hours per week. The team tested error reporting and manual fallback in a rehearsal. Procurement Operations coordinates the pilot log and weekly review. No person is authorized to pause the pilot. Incident backup is not documented. The charter covers four weeks. Recurring staffing and funding after the pilot have not been decided.
